title: Sign in
purpose: Enter your staff account. Your role controls the screens and actions you can use.
options: Email address and password
Sign in
Customer enquiry form for visitors
fields: Email: type your account address.
Password: enter the configured demo password.
next: Home opens after sign-in. To test another role, sign out and use its own account. There is no identity-switch bypass.

title: Customer enquiry
purpose: Let a customer request a solar installation without a staff account.
options: Send enquiry
Send another enquiry after success
Staff sign in
fields: Customer and site: name, phone and installation address.
Solar system: choose 1-5 kW; on-grid, off-grid with battery, or panel hardware set.
Optional: requirements notes and subsidy interest.
next: The saved enquiry appears in the staff project list. Customers do not receive access to staff screens.

title: Home
purpose: See current work and open the right task quickly.
options: Role-specific shortcuts
Counts for active and finished projects
Stage links filter the project list
Recent projects and installer schedule
Money totals only for permitted roles
fields: No typing is required.
next: Choose a work shortcut or project. Installers see their assigned projects only.

title: Customers & projects
purpose: Find a customer, installation site or project.
options: Search by customer, phone, site or project number
Filter by stage
Previous and Next pages
Open project
New enquiry for administrator and sales
fields: Search: free text.
Stage: choose from the saved project stages.
next: Your search, stage and page stay in the address. Back to project list keeps these filters.

title: New staff enquiry
purpose: Create a customer request received by the staff team.
options: Create project
Back to project list
Fill sample enquiry when local test helpers are enabled; review and save separately
Choose a returning customer and an existing site; record another call on the original project when appropriate
Leave system capacity unknown until the survey
Record requested appointment window, access instructions and hazard notes
fields: Customer and site: name, phone, address.
Solar system: capacity, system type, notes, subsidy interest.
Follow-up: source (Website, Referral, Phone, WhatsApp, Walk-in), optional date and responsible sales/admin staff.
next: The new project opens. Record the site survey next.

title: Project workspace
purpose: Keep one customer journey together and show what happens next.
options: Back to the screen you came from
Next-step explanation and Go to this step
Clickable journey stages where your role has access
Project sections: survey, quote/payment, packing/delivery, installation, device history, subsidy, activity
Customer address and phone link
Correct customer details with a reason and version check; phone changes require verification
Review multiple systems and sites, contact history and original billing snapshots
fields: The summary itself has no form.
next: The recommended section depends on the saved state and your role. A handoff message explains which team owns a step you cannot perform.

title: Site survey
purpose: Check that the roof and power supply are suitable before quoting.
options: Record site survey / Record new survey
Save survey
Approve survey / Reject survey: administrator and surveyor only
View latest measurements, survey status, customer needs and follow-up date
fields: Roof measurements: usable area in square metres, direction selected from eight compass directions, tilt in degrees, cable distance in metres.
Electricity: actual monthly bill and grid-suitability checkbox.
Site notes: type observations that fixed choices cannot describe.
next: Approval enables a quotation. Measurements must describe the actual site; demo defaults are not engineering advice.

title: Quotation & payment
purpose: Prepare a price list, record acceptance and track customer payments.
options: Generate quotation or Issue new version: administrator/sales after survey approval
Print quotation/invoice view
Record customer acceptance: administrator/sales
View itemized invoice, paid amount and balance
Record payment: administrator/sales/accounts
Request a 1–20% discount; a separate administrator reviews it and issues a new quote version
Request pre-dispatch order cancellation; finance reviews the credit, then records the actual refund
Create linked additional work with its own survey, quotation, acceptance and invoice
Review pending payments, receipt reversals, credit notes and replacement invoices
fields: Quote: equipment quantities and prices fill from the selected package.
Payment: actual amount in rupees, payment method and transaction/receipt reference.
Payment methods: bank transfer, UPI, cash or card.
next: Acceptance freezes the quoted prices and creates the order. Record the advance before stock is reserved. A payment reference identifies the real receipt; do not invent one for real transactions.

title: Packing & delivery
purpose: Set aside the right equipment, check its serials and record delivery.
options: Reserve stock: administrator/stock team
View required quantities and scanned counts
Type/scan serial, Use camera, Add serial
Optional test picker fills a valid stock serial without saving
Confirm packing & dispatch
Confirm customer delivery
View allocated devices and delivery dates
Receive individual complete lines; only received components start warranty coverage
Record failed delivery, customer refusal or transit damage with current goods custody
Return and replace a damaged serial, then obtain coordinator approval before retrying delivery
fields: Serial: scan the generated Code 128 label, paste it, or use the local test picker.
Delivery is an explicit action; there is no automatic delivery date when dispatching.
next: Every required inverter, controller and battery must be scanned before dispatch. Delivery starts warranties exactly once.

title: Installation & handover
purpose: Assign the job, record work and save proof of handover.
options: Assign technician & time: administrator
Start installation: administrator/assigned installer after delivery
Choose photo / camera file picker
Draw signature, Clear, Save signature or upload PNG alternative
Complete safety checklist and handover
View saved evidence after refresh
Select a lead and additional crew members
Record actual minutes separately for each worker; only the lead signs off
fields: Assignment: choose active installer, start date/time and expected duration in hours.
Handover: installed capacity, measured generation, labour minutes, homeowner name.
Checks: mounting, earthing/safety, wiring/protection, inverter/generation and homeowner instruction.
Evidence: real test photo and drawn or uploaded signature.
next: Completion requires saved photo, signature and checks. Only the assigned installer can open and complete their job; administrators can manage all jobs.

title: Device history (asset passport)
purpose: Trace delivered equipment, coverage and replacements.
options: View product or serial, delivery date, expiry date and coverage
Review old and replacement devices
Open related service work where allowed
fields: No manual data entry on this section.
next: Use the serial or customer search in Repairs & warranty when a fault is reported. Printing or scanning a barcode never resets coverage.

title: Subsidy records
purpose: Track the paperwork for a subsidy application.
options: Choose application status
Save application reference, case owner and next action
Check identity, electricity bill, bank details and installation proof documents
fields: Status: documents pending, submitted, approved, received or not applicable. Choose the responsible staff member as owner.
Reference and next action: type actual case details.
Documents: tick only after checking that they were collected or verified.
next: This is a tracking checklist. It does not determine government eligibility or submit an application.

title: Activity history
purpose: See who saved important changes and when.
options: Read chronological events and actor names
View details allowed for your role
fields: No manual entry. Events are created by successful saved actions.
next: Use this to explain or trace a change. Financial event details are withheld from roles without financial access.

title: Stock & deliveries
purpose: Check equipment quantities, device serials and purchases.
options: Packing queue links to a project
Stock levels: on hand, reserved, available and tracking type
Device serials: search and status
Purchase receipts: supplier, reference, quantity, cost and date
Receive stock: administrator/stock team
Barcode labels
Quarantine a damaged available or allocated device and scan a substitute
Submit physical quantity counts for independent finance review
Track supplier claims, decisions and partial recoveries separately from customer billing
fields: Receipt: choose product; enter supplier, purchase reference, received quantity and unit cost.
Serialized product: one genuine or synthetic test serial per device, one per line. Quantity-tracked materials need no device serial.
next: Duplicate serials are rejected. Labels are printed from records already in the database; a print action never receives stock.

title: Installation jobs
purpose: Review upcoming, in-progress and completed installation work.
options: Open a job directly on its Installation section
See customer, site, capacity, assigned installer and schedule
Installers see only their own work
fields: No typing on the job list. Assignment and completion happen inside the project.
next: Open the job to continue, then use Back to jobs to return.

title: Repairs & warranty
purpose: Support records the problem without guessing the faulty part. The assigned crew diagnoses installed equipment and records completed work.
options: New repair call, customer search and stage filter
Open installed equipment and earlier service requests
Schedule or reschedule a visit
Select faulty components and record repair or replacement
Review separate part and labour coverage
Record estimate approval, save a current photo, complete repair
Print the service document; collect payment if chargeable
Receive faulty devices into quarantine; record customer confirmation or dispute
Create a linked follow-up if the fault returns
fields: Choose the installation, problem category and priority.
Type the reported problem and actual findings.
Choose installed components and available matching serials.
Record actual minutes and agreed selling prices; internal cost remains separate.
Coverage exceptions need an authorized reviewer and a reason.
A changed diagnosis needs approval and a fresh completion photo.
next: Physical completion creates a separate service document, including zero-payable covered lines. Support closes the request only after customer confirmation.

title: Repair visit and diagnosis
purpose: Follow one reported problem from a phone call to a completed visit and customer confirmation. Technicians can open only assigned work.
options: Read the installed equipment, current serials, warranty dates and previous repair history
Open the visit, start work or record no access
Select each faulty component and a compatible replacement from saved stock
Save findings, quantities and work time; the coordinator reviews coverage and selling prices
Record customer approval, upload a fresh completion photo and complete the repair
Record a phone confirmation, dispute, contact note or linked follow-up
Record third-party equipment without granting company warranty
Request parts and confirm readiness before booking a return visit
Record engineering compatibility, customer agreement and price for a substitute model
Request separately reviewed remote or no-fault completion
Recover an unsent diagnosis after losing connection; reconnect and submit manually
fields: The version check prevents a later save from silently overwriting another employee's changes.
Changing diagnosis removes approval and makes earlier photos/signatures historical evidence.
Callout charge starts at zero and uses the saved labour coverage decision. Agree any charge before completion.
Synthetic rehearsal evidence is clearly labelled and is not proof of actual site work.
next: Completion creates one service document and a pending return for replaced equipment. Support closes the request only after customer confirmation.

title: Service invoice or zero-payable statement
purpose: Explain what was replaced and what the customer owes without changing the original installation invoice.
options: See replacement names, quantities and old/new serials
Compare selling value, warranty credit and payable amount
See labour and callout as separate lines
Print the saved service document
Accounts records payment against this service invoice using its payment form
fields: A covered replacement stays visible with zero payable.
Parts, labour and callout use saved coverage decisions and reviewed prices.
Company acquisition and labour costs stay separate from customer selling prices.
The document is labelled as a demo because tax configuration has not been verified.
next: The issued document is frozen. Refunds and credit-note corrections are not implemented and remain blocked acceptance cases.

title: Visits & scheduling
purpose: Plan field visits against real availability, with installation bookings, repair visits, travel and leave checked together.
options: Choose a repair request or survey site
Search a date window, required skill, duration and crew size
Select qualified available workers and a lead
Confirm or reschedule with a reason
See installation appointments and record leave
Review unavailable-worker warnings and record no access
Review aged and urgent requests with target-date explanations
Compare qualified workers by booked hours and a fixed 30-minute travel buffer; ties use name then staff ID
Review capacity, hazard, leave, overrun, acknowledgement and customer-contact follow-ups
fields: Routine dates default to days 3 through 5. Appointment times use IST.
Working hours are 09:00 to 17:00, with a fixed 30-minute travel buffer and configured weekly working days.
When the window is full, the next seven days are searched for alternatives. A coordinator must explicitly choose an alternative.
The server rechecks availability at confirmation; search results do not reserve a worker.
next: The crew opens its visit, records findings and evidence, and completes the appropriate work. A failed visit stays visible for follow-up.

title: Money & reports
purpose: Separate money received, unpaid invoices and installation costs.
options: Choose Today, This week, This month or All time
View cash received, outstanding amounts, stock purchases and completed-job contribution
Open project breakdown
View installer payables; record paid reference
Export CSV
Print report
Pay each installation crew member separately; repeat submissions do not pay twice
fields: Period: select.
Installer payment: enter the actual receipt/payment reference.
next: Contribution means invoiced amount minus recorded material, installation labour and service costs. It is not company net profit; cash and profit are different.

Back to stock

Inactive accounts cannot keep using an existing session.
next: Review flagged future visits after disabling a worker or changing their skills. Coordinators reassign affected appointments.
